finding.claim: StartActionByGet and StartActionByGetAndWait skip validateJustificationRequired, so actions that require a justification run without one. StartAction (api.go:160-163) and StartActionAndWait (api.go:308-311) enforce it.
finding.source: Unauthenticated or low-privilege caller calling the GET execution RPCs (api.go:322-343, 368-382) with no justification.
finding.sink: executor.ExecRequest runs the action; the justification requirement is the protected operation.

trace.note: Only ACL exec check is applied; no justification check in the executor
Guest default justification is empty, so the action runs unjustified

finding.guards_checked: ACL exec check (acl.go:120, executor.go:831-846) is the only gate on this path. Justification is enforced only in StartAction/StartActionAndWait via validateJustificationRequired (api_justification.go:18-24).

finding.claim: RestartAction reuses the stored Justification from the original execution. validateRestartLogEntry only checks the value is non-empty, so system-generated strings such as 'Triggered by cron' satisfy the justification requirement for a human-initiated restart.
finding.source: Authenticated user with exec permission calls RestartActionRequest with the tracking ID of a cron, startup or webhook execution of a justification-required action.
finding.sink: Justification-required action executed without a human justification.

trace.note: Justification copied from original log entry
System justifications such as 'Triggered by cron' are non-empty constants
defaultJustificationForRequest assigns the system string to the stored entry

finding.guards_checked: validateRestartLogEntry (api_log_arguments.go:50-52) checks non-empty only. No check that the justification is human-supplied, and no re-check through validateJustificationRequired. ExecRequest's ACL check still applies to the requester.

finding.claim: Values of password-type action arguments are logged in cleartext at Debug level. The redaction applies only to the shell and exec command strings, not these per-argument log fields.
finding.source: Password-type argument value sent in StartAction request (api.go:159-168) and passed to the executor.
finding.sink: Debug log statements (logrus) on the shell and exec argument paths.

trace.note: Debugf logs 'value': values[arg.Name] for every arg including password
parseActionArguments logs 'value': argValue for every declared arg, including password

finding.guards_checked: redactShellCommand/redactExecArgs (arguments.go:119-147) redact only the final command strings. No redaction on the per-argument debug fields. org policy forbids logging sensitive data at any level.

finding.claim: The OAuth2 session identifier (the state value, which is also the olivetin-sid-oauth cookie value and the server-side session key) is logged at Info on login and at Error on state mismatch, and the OAuth2 authorization code is logged at Debug.
finding.source: Each OAuth2 login via /oauth/login (restapi_auth_oauth2.go:151-188) and each callback at /oauth/callback (:299-334).
finding.sink: Application log output (logrus), which is a sensitive-data sink.

trace.note: Session cookie set to state value
log.Errorf logs query state and cookie state (session id) on mismatch
log.Errorf logs state on not found
lookupOAuth2UserByState uses the cookie value as the session key, no expiry check

finding.guards_checked: The cookie and the state are not logged in redacted form. redactHeaderValuesForLog (frontend.go:61-81) covers request headers only, not application logs. Expiry is enforced only by the sweep on the next OAuth login (restapi_auth_oauth2.go:142-149).

finding.claim: The provider header is read from the client request unconditionally and is not restricted to the trusted proxy. Setting provider: system together with the configured username header makes IsSystemExecution true and bypasses the justification requirement.
finding.source: Client-supplied HTTP request header 'provider' (and the configured username header) when trusted-header auth is enabled.

trace.note: username taken from configured header with no source check
checkUserFromHeaders returns user with non-empty username, ending the chain
justificationProvided returns true for system execution, bypassing the justification check

finding.guards_checked: IsSystemExecution checks the username is not 'guest' only. No check that the provider header came from a trusted proxy. Trusted-header mode is opt-in (authHttpHeaderUsername), so this is conditional on that config.
